description: This file contains shell functions related to upgrading an SD card in a legacy system. It includes functions for checking the image, performing the upgrade, and copying configuration files, involving disk partition and image handling commands.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the partition layout in the provided image matches the current device, determining if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the update process on the SD card, either by replacing partitions if they differ or by writing a full image.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the boot partition of the SD card.
